text:
noah: Heads-up - ran into TLS verification failures when our app uses the Python SDK against Dedicated through an HTTP proxy that terminates TLS with a corp CA. Only triggers when a request is retried.

lina: ouch. sync or async client? quick repro pls.

noah: both. minimal snippet: 
```python
from redwood import Client
cli = Client(api_key='***', base_url='https://dedicated.eu.redwood', proxy='http://proxy.corp:8080', ca_bundle='/etc/certs/corp-root.pem')
# simple call
cli.chat.create(model='rw-v1', input='hi')
```
first attempt succeeds, retry throws: `aiohttp.client_exceptions.ClientConnectorCertificateError: Certificate verify failed: unable to get local issuer certificate`

kevin: classic. REQUESTS_CA_BUNDLE/SSL_CERT_FILE helps for requests but aiohttp ignores env in some setups. Also many users prefer SDK arg over env var for Dedicated/Private.

tara: likely cause: retry logic tears down and recreates the async session without reapplying the SSLContext/ca. sync path might lose mount/verify on some error branches too. we saw similar in another client lib.

noah: dug into the client: RetryMiddleware closes session then `ClientSession()` is called with default SSL. For sync we create a new `requests.Session()` but forget to set `session.verify = ca_bundle` in the reconnect path.

lina: proposed fixes: (A) add explicit `ca_bundle` (str path) and `ssl_context` (advanced) args to Client constructor and wire to both sync/async internals; (B) make retry reuse session or, when recreating, reapply ssl params; (C) document env-var fallback and Dedicated sample. thoughts?

kevin: prefer (A) + (B). (A) gives explicit DX for Private/Dedicated. keep `ca_bundle` easy for most customers and allow `ssl_context` for those who build custom contexts.

tara: agree. implementation notes: for sync set `session.verify = ca_bundle` or pass `verify=...` to requests; for async create `ctx = ssl.create_default_context()` then `ctx.load_verify_locations(cafile=ca_bundle)` and pass to `aiohttp.TCPConnector(ssl=ctx)` so `ClientSession(connector=...)` owns it. ensure retry code either reuses connector or reconstructs connector with same ctx.

devops-bot: telemetry: 8 errors in the last 7 days tagged "proxy-tls-terminated" from Dedicated clusters eu-1 and apac-2. No open PRs referenced.

noah: workaround for customers in the meantime: mount CA at /etc/redwood/corp.pem and instantiate Client(ca_bundle='/etc/redwood/corp.pem') in their app. That ensures the initial session uses the CA; also suggestion to set `max_retries=0` while we patch, if acceptable.

lina: i'll own the API surface. we'll add `ca_bundle: Optional[str] = None` and `ssl_context: Optional[ssl.SSLContext] = None` to Client ctor. validate that both aren't contradicting and document precedence.

kevin: add a small unit + integration test: a local proxy in pytest that returns 502 first, 200 second, with the proxy presenting the corp CA cert. assert chat.create succeeds when using ca_bundle across forced retry. keep timeouts low to avoid flakiness.

tara: file an issue and link design + tests. also add a note to devex docs for Dedicated/Private about proxy setups + examples for mounting certs and common env vars.

noah: created draft PR https://github.com/redwood-inference/sdk/pull/512 - WIP. It wires ca_bundle/ssl_context through both clients, preserves ssl on retry, and adds the integration test. assigning to @lina and @kevin for review.

lina: thanks — assigning to platform/py-sdk milestone next-patch. will add a short migration note for Private customers and a snippet for sample-apps repo. :thumbsup:

noah: will update the PR with the test infra notes and a tiny sample-app change. will ping when CI finishes.

kevin: small naming nit: call the constructor param `ca_bundle` (path) and accept `ssl_context` optional for advanced users. good to have both.

tara: once merged we should ship a short blurb in the Dedicated onboarding docs about `ca_bundle` usage and the env var fallbacks. tagging docs later.

noah: thanks everyone. follow-up after PR lands.
